tool_args.rationale: The explicit high-frequency sign-oscillation signature and the repeated sign reversals in the paid rows trigger scoped abstention. No model was submitted for fresh confirmation at H = 1.1 and RMSE tolerance 0.045.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied laws cannot reproduce the observed sign reversals.
With positive u_now, this law permits at most one sign change as H increases; the observations show three.
The high-frequency sign-oscillation signature already triggers scoped abstention.
This probe does not address the oscillatory response.
